Riley (People Ops): Quick thread, nursery timing + payroll question for Casey's upcoming leave starting 2026-11-01. Who's covering interviews and who needs the handoff doc?

Casey: Planning for 12 weeks. Will be offline first 6 then check email weekly. Can prepare a 2-page runbook and a 30m walkthrough before leave.

Dana (Manager): I can cover priority interviews for the first 2 weeks of leave. For the rest we should either delay hiring or ask Hiring-bot to post a short-term temp.

Riley (People Ops): Payroll note : to apply Redwood supplement Casey must sign Supplement Election by payroll cutoff 2026-10-15. Payroll-bot will send reminder 2026-10-01.

Payroll-bot: Reminder scheduled: Supplement Election form due 2026-10-15 for Casey. Request ID LR-20261101-11.

Casey: I'll sign by 10/10. Also can anyone take over the weekly product sync and the candidate debriefs?

Dana (Manager): I'll take the product sync first 2 weeks. Team, can someone pick up candidate debriefs weeks 3-6?

Riley (People Ops): Hiring-bot, can you prepare a 10-week contractor req and a short interview pack?

Hiring-bot: Draft req created: REQ-TEMP-5142. Duration 10 weeks. Interview pack link: https://internal/recruiting/REQ-TEMP-5142-pack.

Dana (Manager): OK sounding good. Casey please add runbook + top 5 priorities. We'll finalize coverage by 2026-09-30.

Casey: Will add runbook tonight and ping when uploaded. Thanks all! :heart:
